n: Machine audition curriculum with Scratch and Magenta (MIT)
t: An MIT thesis describing a middle school unit on how humans and machines hear.
steps: Find the thesis record on MIT's DSpace.
Read the sections on the curriculum and the pilot.
Check whether the Scratch music extension is publicly available.
Ask IT before installing any extension.
Choose which activities work with plain Scratch.
Plan a first lesson on how people and machines hear sound.
